newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 1.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Tuesday's Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - Twentieth Century Fox of News Corp Ltd has put into pre-production a film version of the Marvel Comics quartet, "The Fantastic Four". It is tentatively scheduled to launch for summer 1998.
HOLLYWOOD - Imagine Entertainment has closed a deal to produce playwright-author Neil Simon's next romantic comedy.

HOLLYWOOD - Warner Bros of Time Warner Inc is poised to go forward with its own "Formula One" race car project starring Antonio Banderas at the same time as New Line Cinema of Turner Broadcasting System Inc is to start filming its own "Formula One". Neither studio would comment on the potential conflict.
